original_metadata_description: Node-agnostic cross-run QoR analytics agent. Aggregates Common Design Envelopes, fits PPA trajectories over explicitly ordered runs, and flags regressions against a baseline USING METRIC POLARITY so improvements are never reported as regressions. Polarity is resolved from a known-metric table or a caller declaration and never guessed; unclassifiable changes are gated rather than blessed. Reports per-metric sample size and checks comparability before pooling. Consumes envelopes and never re-runs a flow stage.
original_agent_description: Node-agnostic cross-run QoR analytics agent. Aggregates Common Design Envelopes across runs, blocks, and nodes; fits PPA trajectories over EXPLICITLY ORDERED runs (slope + goodness-of-fit, minimum three points); and flags regressions against a baseline using METRIC POLARITY, so a slack improvement and an area regression of the same magnitude are no longer both reported as regressions. Polarity is resolved from a known-metric table or a caller declaration and is NEVER guessed: an unclassifiable change is gated rather than blessed. Reports per-metric sample size and checks design/corner/PDK comparability before pooling. It consumes envelopes and never re-runs a flow stage.
